source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies sharp bounds on the variance of the difference-in-means estimator under completely randomized experiments from observable marginal potential-outcome information.
The paper casts causal partial identification with K observed potential-outcome marginals as multi-marginal optimal transport and obtains exact partial identified sets.
The article characterizes admissible quadratic variance bounds and formulates selection of a conservative bound as a convex optimization problem for interference and complex designs.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and finite-population CLT regularity conditions
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes general finite-population central limit theorems for randomization-based causal inference, including maximum-deviation style regularity conditions.
The paper develops local asymptotic decision theory for treatment rules using root-sample-size local alternatives and Gaussian limit experiments.
The paper provides randomization-based estimation, conservative variance estimation, inference, and power analysis for direct and spillover effects in two-stage randomized experiments.
The paper studies randomized-saturation experimental design through regression-model power calculations and analytical design insights under maintained outcome structure.
The paper characterizes minimax-regret treatment selection for multi-arm location families and specializes to arbitrary fixed multivariate-normal covariance matrices.
The paper approximates minimax-regret treatment rules by discretizing nature's action space and applying fictitious play/coarsening.
